name: techdella/post-card
title: Post card
description: One Journal post: cover (featured image, or the template cover with the category in type), category · read time, title link.

techdella.help: postId: a published post. Without one, the inline item {title, category, cover, minutes, url, image} renders with an 'Example' label (for previews only; use post ideas from the content calendar, not invented articles). tone 0–3 picks the cover surface.
